subject: Post-call: procurement readiness + SOC2 / commercial path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stardust.ai>, Anna Morales <anna.morales@stardust.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: procurement readiness + SOC2 / commercial path

Hi Liam / Anna — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Summary from the discovery call:
- Use case: internal search + summaries for product help center (high QPS, strict latency).
- Sizing: estimated steady-state ~200k tokens/mo, peaks ~1M tokens/mo during campaigns.
- Security/compliance: your security and legal teams require SOC 2 Type II evidence + executed DPA before production access.
- Procurement preference: you mentioned procurement usually issues a PO (net-30) but the stakeholder team can do card if needed for faster pilots.
- Marketplace: Anna asked whether we are available via AWS Marketplace (for financing/PO flow).

Actions we committed to today:
1) Attachments: SOC2 summary (high-level), draft DPA with our standard terms, and a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) for procurement and onboarding.
2) Please confirm preferred commercial path: PO (Invoice -> Net terms) vs. card for initial pilot. If PO, we’ll need the purchase order workflow + billing contact.
3) Security ask: if your security team has a questionnaire, share it — we’ll route to Security to complete.
4) Marketplace: we do support AWS Marketplace listing; we’ll confirm specifics (metered vs. SaaS) if that’s the route you prefer.

Proposed near-term timeline:
- This week: legal/security review of DPA and SOC2 evidence.
- Week 1–2: procurement issues PO (if PO path) or card processed for pilot.
- Week 2–3: onboarding kickoff once payment/PO received.

Please reply with the preferred commercial path and the name/email for your procurement contact. I’ll follow up with the invoice sample and DocuSign link for the DPA.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, DPA_redlines.docx, mutual_action_plan.xlsx
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stardust.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Anna Morales <anna.morales@stardust.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stardust.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness + SOC2 / commercial path

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A couple clarifications from procurement/legal side: 

- Commercial path: Stardust prefers PO (we'll do Net-30). Card can be used for very short pilot budgets but procurement needs to own production billing.
- Security: we require SOC 2 Type II report (we need the actual report or a download link; the summary is helpful but Security will want the evidence).
- DPA: attaching our standard redlines (procurement_requirements.xlsx will follow). Legal will review your DPA; we prefer to see whether you can accept a few of our commercial DPA changes.

Timeline: our legal can turn around within ~7–10 business days once they have the SOC2 report and your DPA edits. Procurement can prepare a PO once legal signs off.

Other asks: can you share a sample invoice and confirm whether Redwood supports invoicing to a PO number and remittance instructions? Also, is Redwood available on AWS Marketplace (we’d prefer this path if it keeps procurement within the marketplace flow).

-Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement | Stardust AI
liam.oconnor@stardust.ai

Looping in quick ops notes —
- We have SOC 2 Type II full report available behind a secured link; I’ll share the link (S3) and can gate access to the Stardust security contact.
- Redwood accepts PO invoicing and can do Net-30; we also accept card for pilot.
- For AWS Marketplace: we support both SaaS subscriptions and metered SaaS listings. Marketplace route usually speeds procurement but requires listing work (we have an active listing in progress; target go-live ~3 weeks).
- Pricing: for a committed PO we can offer a 15–25% commitment discount depending on term and volume. See attached pricing-sheet.pdf for a quick reference.

If we need to accelerate, I can approve an invoice-for-card pilot to get them started while legal finishes the DPA redlines.

Hi Liam / Anna — appreciate the quick replies and the procurement_requirements sheet. Confirming next steps from Redwood: 

1) SOC2 report: we’ll share a secure, time-limited S3 link to the SOC2 Type II report for your security reviewer by EOD today. Link included in related_links for tracking. Access will be restricted to the emails you list.
2) DPA: I’ve uploaded our standard DPA to DocuSign and started a signature request for Stardust. We’re happy to review a few customer-specific clauses; we’ve flagged non-negotiables in the redlines doc (attached).
3) Commercial path: we accept PO (Net-30) and will process an invoice to your PO number. For pilots, card is OK to accelerate. If you prefer Marketplace, we can go that route — it typically shortens procurement but requires the listing go-live (target ~3 weeks).
4) Pricing & discount: Sean shared the pricing sheet. If Stardust commits to a 12-month PO at the volume we discussed, we can extend a 20% commit discount; we can formalize in the quote once you confirm term and expected tokens.

Proposed milestones (MAP):
- Today: SOC2 link + DPA DocuSign sent.
- By 26 Feb: legal review complete (target).
- By 03 Mar: PO issued / card processed and onboarding kickoff scheduled.

I’ll follow up with the invoice sample and a DocuSign link in a separate email (sending now). If you can share the procurement contact name/email for PO routing and the security reviewer’s email, I’ll grant permissions on the SOC2 link.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Stardust onboarded.

Kind regards,
Marissa Cole
